conditions.distribution: Exact Forge 1.20.1 artifacts are required on the managed client and logical server

conditions.world_generation: New structures apply only to newly generated chunks

change.summary: Add Towns and Towers plus the remembered Dungeons and Taverns structure set while retaining Terralith biome coverage and JEM progression ownership

modifiers.before: Towns and Towers and Dungeons and Taverns structures were unavailable
modifiers.after: Both native structure catalogs, placement sets, templates, loot and supporting functions are available in new chunks

modifiers.before: The two new artifacts can reset eight shared vanilla structure-biome tags and discard prior Terralith additions
modifiers.after: A high-priority JEM Paxi datapack adds the exact Terralith entries back without replacing the new mods' native tag members

modifiers.before: JEM Twelve Eyes owns the final empty witch loot table for campaign gating
modifiers.after: JEM Twelve Eyes remains the final owner. The Dungeons and Taverns emerald addition does not bypass the established gate

cause.owner: Towns and Towers, Dungeons and Taverns, Cristel Lib and the JEM Paxi compatibility layer

rationale.purpose: Expand Major Update 4 exploration with the requested village, outpost, tavern and dungeon structure catalogs without erasing installed terrain-mod compatibility
rationale.decision_source: The user directly requested Towns and Towers and described another structure mod retained from the old Iron's Spells-era pack. Local profile evidence identifies that mod as Dungeons and Taverns
rationale.implementation_choices: Reuse exact official-hash artifacts from the retained Forge 1.20.1 profile, keep native spacing and add only the smallest data compatibility layer required by the installed Terralith and JEM Twelve Eyes owners

introduced.summary: Add Towns and Towers, Dungeons and Taverns and Cristel Lib with JEM structure-tag compatibility

history.summary: Selected the exact old-profile artifacts, confirmed official hashes and preserved Terralith and Twelve Eyes ownership

relations: Towns and Towers and Dungeons and Taverns -> new-chunk structure generation
shared vanilla biome tags -> JEM Paxi Terralith restoration
Dungeons and Taverns witch loot -> existing JEM Twelve Eyes final override
notes: All Towns and Towers structures remain enabled at native 1.12 spacing values
Cristel Lib structure enablement and placement files match the retained old JEM profile and native 1.1.6 defaults
The retained old profile and official Modrinth releases have identical SHA-512 values
No existing chunk or structure is regenerated
MineRENT, main, stable JustEnoughMods and the immutable release baseline remain unchanged
unresolved: Minecraft launch, fresh-chunk generation and player acceptance were not performed
